subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public `PluginStatusProvider`/`registerStatusProvider` SDK seam for plugin-contributed TUI footer status now, and if so what method name, return shape, multiplicity, and render boundary should become the supported contract?
rationale: This crosses the public Plugin SDK and TUI rendering boundary; automation can verify the gap but cannot safely choose the long-term API contract or how it coordinates with the broader footer customization tracker.

options.title: Review the linked SDK seam
options.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the narrow API/registry implementation, then keep footer rendering details on the broader tracker.

options.title: Defer to broader footer design
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the API until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53774 settles ordering, truncation, theming, and placement semantics.

options.title: Reject persistent footer plugin status
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers want `/status`, `/usage`, logs, or plugin-owned UI surfaces to remain the supported status path instead of adding a TUI footer SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Review the linked SDK seam
recommendation.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72557 as the narrow API/registry implementation, then keep footer rendering details on the broader tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin SDK compatibility and TUI product direction, and this person has the strongest current history across those files in the available evidence.
